biggest_catch: The membership buys ACCESS, not bookings: Voice123's official plans page charges $495 to see 50% of matching projects and $888 for 65% — and with ~1 million talents on the platform per the same page, there is no guaranteed project, booking, or payback on the fee.
catches: Paid tiers gate project visibility: $495 → 50% of matching projects, $888 → 65%, higher tier → 80%; the fee buys invitations, not work.
The official plans page cites ~1 million talents, 23,000 projects posted in 12 months, and a $350 average project budget — heavy competition per project.
Free Standard membership exists, so the paid tier is optional, but its $495/$888 cost is only recouped if you win enough projects at your own rates.
Talent keeps 100% of earnings (zero deductions) — that is per booking, not a promise of any booking volume.

steps: Go to https://voice123.com/plans and review the membership tiers: free Standard, Pro $495 (50% of matching projects), Pro $888 (65%), higher tier (80%).
Create your free talent profile at https://voice123.com/talent and upload demos.
Optionally upgrade to a paid tier for larger project visibility — weigh the $495/$888 cost against the $350 average project budget and ~1M-talent competition.
Audition for posted projects matching your profile; Voice123's official guidance says new actors might start at $100–$500 per project.
Deliver approved work and keep 100% of earnings — Voice123 takes zero deductions.
